| N1 | defect | MAJOR | BLOCKER, new in R2. A tmux outage now halts ALL delivery, and the plan-117 witness can no longer see it. In drain_once the line `let live_panes = self.tmux.list_panes().await?;` sits BEFORE the claim loop and AFTER the peek early-return, so its `?` returns Err from drain_once with handled == 0 and no handle_claim runs at all. Before this commit every tmux error was PER-RECIPIENT: list_panes lived inside handle_claim's proc-none branch, and both it and fresh_injection_verdict did release_or_backoff and then returned Err into the `deferred` slot, so the pass CONTINUED and served every recipient queued behind the failure. That is the plan-117 invariant, and the long comment asserting it ('ONE RECIPIENT'S FAILURE IS NOT THE PASS'S FAILURE') is one of the blocks this commit deleted, so nothing in the source now warns the next author off reintroducing it. Reachability is trivial: `tmux list-panes -a` exits 1 when no server is running and TmuxAdapter::finish maps any non-zero exit to Err, so a daemon with queued work and a tmux server that is down or restarting delivers NOTHING on every tick — including UDS socket deliveries that need no tmux at all, since UdsTransport::discover resolves by PID FIRST (sessions_dir/&lt;pid&gt;.json) and only falls back to a pane suffix. The peek short-circuit means this fires only when there IS queued work, which is exactly when it matters. Compounding it: the guard written for this property, a_recipient_whose_pane_has_vanished_does_not_starve_the_queue_behind_it, STILL PASSES but no longer for its own reason — its dead recipient now short-circuits to fail_claim and never reaches the tmux call the test was built around. The guard is present and no longer load-bearing, which is why the regression arrived green. Smallest fix: do not propagate — treat a list_panes error as the pass's deferred error (return an empty roster and defer, or restore the per-recipient shape) so live recipients are still served, and add a FakeTmux list_panes failure mode so the plan-117 test can actually exercise it. | crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs:107 | [ ] unchecked | — | — | — | — | Source chain traced end to end in crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs drain_once and crates/tmux/src/lib.rs (list_panes -&gt; stdout -&gt; run -&gt; finish, non-zero =&gt; Err). Empirically measured by this reviewer: `tmux -L pij-probe-nonexistent list-panes -a` =&gt; exit 1. NOT executed as a test: no fake supports a failing list_panes and this review is read-only on code; that missing fake is part of the gap. |
